purpose: Authored training situations; one fresh rollout per case, feedback from actual compiler/action/tool checks, no historical hint reuse.

cases.prompt: We covered equivalent fractions: multiply numerator and denominator by the same nonzero factor. Give me a resumable four-question OpenUI Quiz with objective and open-ended items, including a recipe using half-cup and quarter-cup measures. Wait for submission.

We finished calculating discounts and distinguishing savings from sale price. Give me a resumable four-question OpenUI Quiz, mixing objective and open-ended formats, on 10% of $80, 20% off $100 and comparing $10 off different original prices. Wait before discussing answers.

We finished zero-based loop boundaries, last index length minus one, i < length and empty arrays. Give me four resumable OpenUI Flashcards that require recalling concrete examples before revealing an answer.
Create an OpenUI Simulation for a pack costing $6. Let me change its weight from 100 g to 1000 g and show the price per 100 g. Use a workspace lifecycle and a prediction in the brief.
I think doubling only the numerator always gives an equivalent fraction. Ask me one focused OpenUI text Question to check my reasoning before giving the answer.
I think 20% off a $100 price means I pay $20. Ask one focused OpenUI text Question to check my understanding and wait for my answer.
